name: arXiv:2607.24787 - SpecPrefetch: Parameter-Efficient Expert Prefetching for Sparse MoE Foundation Models
notes: arXiv:2607.24787, first submitted 2026-06-24 as v1, revised 2026-07-30 as v2 (this version). The abs page names no venue and carries no proceedings comment. A title search on 2026-10-18 returned only the arXiv abs, PDF, and HTML pages, no Crossref proceedings deposit, so this source is the preprint. Authors Jinwei Kong, Runqi Meng, Fanyi Wang, Wentao Qiu, Haotian Hu, Yongjian Zhou, Zhenhua Ge. The abstract says code and weights will be released upon acceptance; the v2 HTML does not link a repository. Numbers in the paper record were read from the v2 HTML at https://arxiv.org/html/2607.24787v2 on 2026-10-18: Figure 1 for the per-layer stall and the prefetch-window measurement, Section 3 for the adapter and the budget, Table 2 for ExpertRecall, Section 4.1 for the Snapdragon setup and the 1.94 MB expert, Section 4.4 and Table 4 for the on-device throughput, Table 5 for ReadyRecall against naive prefetch, Figure 4 for the budget sweep, Figure 5 for the storage sweep. The paper is its own measurement; there is no independent reproduction. The on-device numbers are a phone with experts on NVMe or emulated slower storage, not a GPU with experts in host DRAM.
